title: Please continue the excellent work! cheer up 💪
body: I love this app—it’s easy to use, has a clean and simple design, a good choice of colors, and smooth effects (?). It makes me want to keep track and open the app. However, there’s one thing I’d like to complain about: the goal-setting option. I want to be able to type the number for my goal instead of having to scroll for a minute. For example, I want to set my daily steps goal to 10k, but I can’t just type it in, which is a bit inconvenient. Anyways, you did a great job. I’m sure to support you, and I believe it’s worth every Thai bath. 👀💖
